Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “maternal grandfather” by following the stepfamily line (Ken Howard’s father) instead of the mother’s biological father. Despite evidence that Ann Landers is Adam’s grandmother, the Planner incorrectly inferred Ken Howard’s father as the maternal grandfather, rather than Ann Landers’ husband, Jules (Julius) Lederer.
